enchantments.tooltip: +5 Orb Bonus: While this orb is equipped and you are actively blocking, you gain a +5 orb bonus to all saving throws, as well as Acid, Cold, Fire, Electric, and Sonic resistances.
Force Blast 4: This weapon ripples with intense force, dealing 4d6 Force damage on a successful hit, and an additional 4d6 Force damage on a critical hit.
Shield Bashing +14%: +14% Enhancement bonus to your chance of a Secondary Shield Bash. This stacks with bonuses granted by any relevant feats.
Impactful 4: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to ripple with force, dealing 4 to 24 force on each hit.
Quality Doublestrike 2%: Passive: 2% Quality bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
